task.title: Claim one exact due schedule revision
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/835 by exposing exact revision-bound schedule reservation with a caller-owned cutoff.
acceptance_criteria: Validate identity and numeric inputs before storage access.
Delegate revision, lifecycle, and inclusive due checks to ScheduleStore::claim.
Fail closed without dispatch, worker identity, materialization, or execution authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Focused claim integration tests failed because claim was an unrecognized subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the required success, absence or conflict, validation, and fail-closed paths.

attempts.summary: Implemented the bounded contract and refactored only demonstrated duplication.
attempts.diagnostic: The capability existed below the requested boundary or required one new typed kernel operation.
attempts.patch: Added a thin claim adapter, reused complete schedule serialization, and covered future, stale, missing, terminal, malformed, and storage failures.

outcome.summary: Callers can reserve one exact due intent while time selection and all execution authority remain explicit and external.

lessons: Pass time as caller-owned evidence instead of reading ambient time.
Reservation is inert lifecycle state, not worker identity, permission, or dispatch.
